title: Record page v3: an empty body table collapses to one line that reads 「暂无相关记录 偏离 新建」 — the empty text before the table's own title
body:
repo:hotclm#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUw8KJgAwuwk6sqYLD

Filing gate: ① user-visible defect, reproduced in the browser on @objectstack 18.3.0 (hotclm 18.3 upgrade pass; hotclm decision-box batch 11, maintainer 「同意」 2026-11-03T16:16:59Z).

**Symptom.** hotclm's contract page has six body tables. When one is empty (here 偏离 / Deviations, 0 rows) it is not drawn like its siblings (header row with title, count and 新建 above the table). It collapses to a single bordered line whose text reads, left to right, **「暂无相关记录  偏离  + 新建」**: the empty-state sentence first, the table's title after it, in italic grey. Read aloud it says "no related records deviations new". The same happens to the renewals card when it is a body table (「合同 0 暂无相关记录」).

**Expected.** An empty body table keeps its header (title, 0, 新建) and shows the empty state under it — the shape the non-empty tables and the pre-18.3 `record:related_list` both draw.

Evidence: /mnt/project-files/hotclm-objectstack-18-3-upgrade/02-detail-counsel-4.png (bottom of the details column). Platform version: 18.3.0.
